arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/tg-compare.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git -c credential.helper= clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
echo REPOSITORY_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo VPS_SHA=$(cat /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.verified-source-commit)
python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast,subprocess
names=('scripts/safe_runtime.py','scripts/operation_policy.py','scripts/member_groups.py','scripts/approval_store.py')
for name in names:
 p=Path(name)
 if not p.is_file():continue
 src=p.read_text()
 t=ast.parse(src)
 funcs=[(n.name,n.lineno) for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef))]
 print('ACTIVE_MODULE',name,'LINES',len(src.splitlines()),'FUNCTIONS',funcs[:95])
 for i,line in enumerate(src.splitlines(),1):
  if any(x in line for x in ('approved_users_done','approved_user_ids_done','approved_users.txt','def process','def record','def load_state','def read','status =','status ==','member_added','member_actions','member_adds','record_success')):
   print('ACTIVE_MATCH',name,i,line.strip()[:165])
  if i>1350:break
legacy=subprocess.run(['git','show','1862998844782764d263ee8e49a1476a7f86beac:main.py'],capture_output=True,text=True)
if legacy.returncode:print('LEGACY_COMMIT_NOT_IN_SHALLOW')
else:
 src=legacy.stdout;t=ast.parse(src)
 print('LEGACY_ENG_FUNCS',[(n.name,n.lineno) for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and any(w in n.name for w in ('scrape','invite','adder','user','group','filter','active','worth'))][:85])
print('TEST_FILES',len(list(Path('tests').glob('test_*.py'))))
print('PREFLIGHT_PASS')
PY
